details: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed on Friday, November 13, 2026, to have targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar installation in Bahrain. This alleged strike, reported by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, has heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Neither the US nor Bahraini authorities have yet confirmed the Iranian claims. The broader cryptocurrency market experienced a significant selloff on this day, with Bitcoin dropping below $70,000, partly due to these renewed geopolitical concerns.
title: Iran Claims Strike on US Radar in Bahrain Amid Rising Middle East Tensions

details: Expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December 2026 have intensified following higher-than-expected US inflation data. This outlook has strengthened the US dollar, making liquidity-sensitive risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, less attractive. The increased probability of tighter monetary policy and a stronger dollar contribute to the current bearish sentiment in the crypto market.
sourceName: Reuters (as cited by Global Banking & Finance Review)
title: Fed Rate Hike Expectations and Stronger Dollar Drive Crypto Downturn
